items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Stella is mentioned by the interviewer as a sister of the interviewee (Eutris), but the interviewee does not speak about her or confirm any personal relationship.

ctx.x: To put them in order, who was born first?
Pauline is the oldest and then Emma, then Annie May, then Stella - well, the one that died, I don't know - she must have been between - she was before Stella, and Eutris is the baby.
What I'm trying to get was like, who was born first?
